items.name: Tim
items.text: Absolutely love my new pool! The team did an amazing job super friendly professional and quick. They kept everything clean explained each step and made sure I was happy with the everything . The pool looks fantastic and has completely transformed my yard. Highly recommend them if you’re thinking about getting a pool!

items.name: Chris
items.text: Thanks again to you and Wayne - this is truly great service. And thank you for understanding my situation. Normally I would have been happy to wait. So I really appreciate it. Wayne struggled a bit as it was not the pump. After a lot of searching he found a loose connection in the db board. I appreciate his commitment to the task. Outstanding. Thanks again Werner! I am off to sweep the pool by moonlight! 👍😎🤠
